notes.text: Overhauled how we do message view scrolling to fix a KitKat issue. Thanks to Joe Steele!
Hardened TLS cipher suites and versions
K-9 no longer adds blank lines to composed messages if there is no quoted text
Fixed serveral issues related to message drafts
Better cleanup of old data when deleting an account
Worked around a bug in KitKat that stopped settings import from working
Updated German, Greek, Japanese, Korean, Lithuanian, Portugese, Russian and Slovak translations
